title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "B" Range/Performance
plain: On engines with a second exhaust pressure control valve, that valve is not producing the result the computer expects when commanded.
symptoms: Possible loss of power on diesels

causes.name: Sticking valve from soot or rust

checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch it move
Check the valve for soot or rust holding it in place
Inspect the wiring and connector
fix: Usually freeing up or replacing the valve, or replacing the pressure sensor.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "B" Low
plain: The control circuit for the second exhaust pressure control valve is reading lower than expected.
symptoms: Possible loss of power on diesels
checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch it move
Check the valve for soot or rust holding it in place
Inspect the wiring and connector
fix: Repair the wiring or replace the valve actuator.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "B" High
plain: The control circuit for the second exhaust pressure control valve is reading higher than expected, often from an open circuit.
symptoms: Possible loss of power on diesels
checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch it move
Check the valve for soot or rust holding it in place
Inspect the wiring and connector
fix: Repair the wiring or replace the valve actuator.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "B" Intermittent
plain: The signal in the second exhaust pressure control valve circuit is cutting in and out.
symptoms: Possible loss of power on diesels
checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch it move
Check the valve for soot or rust holding it in place
Inspect the wiring and connector
fix: Repair the wiring or connector, or replace the valve.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "B" Stuck Open
plain: The computer thinks the second exhaust pressure control valve is stuck open, so it cannot build back pressure when needed.
symptoms: Possible loss of power on diesels

causes.name: Valve seized open by soot or rust

checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch it move
Check the valve for soot or rust holding it in place
Inspect the wiring and connector
fix: Usually freeing up or replacing the valve or actuator.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "B" Stuck Closed
plain: The computer thinks the second exhaust pressure control valve is stuck closed, which traps exhaust and can cut power and raise exhaust temperatures.
symptoms: Possible loss of power on diesels

causes.name: Valve seized closed by soot or rust

checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch it move
Check the valve for soot or rust holding it in place
Inspect the wiring and connector
fix: Usually freeing up or replacing the valve or actuator.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "B" Position Sensor/Switch Circuit
plain: The computer sees an electrical problem with the sensor that reports where the second exhaust pressure control valve is.
symptoms: Possible loss of power on diesels

causes.name: Failed position sensor (often built into the valve actuator)

checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch its position reading
Inspect the position sensor connector and wiring
fix: Usually a new valve actuator or a wiring repair.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "B" Position Sensor/Switch Circuit Range/Performance
plain: The position reading for the second exhaust pressure control valve does not match what the valve should be doing.
symptoms: Possible loss of power on diesels
checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch its position reading
Inspect the position sensor connector and wiring
fix: Usually freeing up or replacing the valve or actuator.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "B" Position Sensor/Switch Circuit Low
plain: The position sensor signal for the second exhaust pressure control valve is lower than possible.
symptoms: Possible loss of power on diesels
checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch its position reading
Inspect the position sensor connector and wiring
fix: Replace the actuator or sensor, or repair the wiring.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "B" Position Sensor/Switch Circuit High
plain: The position sensor signal for the second exhaust pressure control valve is higher than possible.
symptoms: Possible loss of power on diesels
checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch its position reading
Inspect the position sensor connector and wiring
fix: Replace the actuator or sensor, or repair the wiring.

title: Exhaust Pressure Control Valve "B" Position Sensor/Switch Circuit Intermittent/Erratic
plain: The position signal for the second exhaust pressure control valve is cutting in and out or jumping around.
symptoms: Possible loss of power on diesels
checks: Command the valve with a scan tool and watch its position reading
Inspect the position sensor connector and wiring
fix: Repair the wiring or connector, or replace the actuator.
